name: Sam trung nuong
summary: Sam trứng nướng is grilled horseshoe crab with eggs. Dân Việt says people take the male off the female, clean the animal, and grill it on charcoal until cooked. They then shred the meat and the eggs with spring onion, garlic, chili, cilantro, and crushed peanuts.
howToEat: Grill, then shred and mix. The story calls the eggs fatty and the meat sweet, and says crab and ghẹ do not match it.
